correctness.rationale: Marked adjacent arc (i,i+1) contracts bijectively to a partition on n-1 points. It cannot introduce a crossing, but it is nested by each contracted arc (a,b) with a<i<b; old crossing/nesting pair order is preserved. Because E[N-C]=0 by 2-arc equidistribution, covariance gap is sum over contractions of h_i divided by B_n, namely D_{n-1}/B_n where D_m=sum_arc(b-a-1) over m-partitions. Aggregate dimension identity D_m=(m+4)B_{m+1}-2B_{m+2} follows from marking blocks and cut counting, so final gap n+3-2B_{n+1}/B_n. Exact rational Bell recurrence independently checked gap 0,0,1/15,5/26,73/203,490/877 for n2..7. Positivity follows from d>=0 and a nontrivial arc spanning one point for m>=3; Bell ratios B_{n+1}/B_n=O(n/log n) yield normalized limit 1.
